Description: All traffic encrypted via HTTPS. No exceptions. Modern browsers warn on HTTP.
Implementation: Vercel/Netlify auto-provision SSL. If self-hosted use Let's Encrypt (free).
Verification: Check: green lock in browser. Run SSL Labs test (ssllabs.com).
Risk_If_Ignored: Users see 'Not Secure' warning. Google penalizes HTTP in rankings.
Giantiny_Note: Giantiny ③ Vercel handles this automatically — zero effort

Description: Never store passwords in plain text. Use bcrypt (12 rounds) or argon2id.
Implementation: Supabase Auth handles this automatically. If custom: use bcrypt with cost factor 12.
Verification: Check auth implementation. Verify hashes stored not plaintext.
Risk_If_Ignored: One database leak = all user passwords exposed. Legal liability.
Giantiny_Note: Giantiny ③ Supabase Auth = code handles security not human processes

Description: Never commit API keys or secrets to git. Use environment variables.
Implementation: Use .env.local (gitignored) locally. Vercel/platform env vars for production. Rotate keys quarterly.
Verification: Run: git log --all -p | grep -i 'api_key\\|secret\\|password'. Should return nothing.
Risk_If_Ignored: Leaked API keys = unauthorized access. AWS bills of $50K+ from exposed keys are common.

Description: Validate and sanitize ALL user input. Both client-side and server-side.
Implementation: Use Zod for input validation. Parameterized queries for DB. Sanitize HTML output.
Verification: Test: try submitting <script>alert('xss')</script> in forms. Should be sanitized.
Risk_If_Ignored: XSS attacks. SQL injection. Data corruption. User data theft.

Description: Verify identity (authn) AND permissions (authz) on every request. Use established provider.
Implementation: Use Supabase Auth or NextAuth. Implement Row Level Security. Check permissions server-side.
Verification: Test: try accessing other users' data. Should return 403/404.
Risk_If_Ignored: Unauthorized data access. GDPR violation. Trust destruction.

Description: Automated daily backups with point-in-time recovery. Test restore quarterly.
Implementation: Enable Supabase PITR (Pro plan). Or pg_dump cron for self-hosted.
Verification: Restore from backup quarterly to verify it works.
Risk_If_Ignored: Data loss. Irrecoverable. Founder's worst nightmare.
Giantiny_Note: Giantiny ④ $25/mo for PITR = cheapest insurance. Financial fat protects you

Description: Limit API requests per IP/user. Prevents abuse and DDoS.
Implementation: Vercel Edge Middleware or Upstash Redis rate limiter. 100 req/min for API.
Verification: Test: send 200 requests/min. Should get 429 after limit.
Risk_If_Ignored: API abuse. Server overload. Unexpected cloud bills.

Description: Only allow requests from your own domains. Block all others.
Implementation: Set Access-Control-Allow-Origin to your domain(s) only. Never use *.
Verification: Test: make API request from different domain. Should be blocked.
Risk_If_Ignored: Anyone can call your API from any website. Data theft risk.

Description: Scan npm packages for known vulnerabilities. Auto-update patch versions.
Implementation: Run npm audit weekly. Enable GitHub Dependabot. Review before updating major versions.
Verification: Run: npm audit. Should show 0 critical/high vulnerabilities.
Risk_If_Ignored: Supply chain attacks. node-ipc, colors.js incidents prove this is real.

Description: Encrypt sensitive data in database. PII financial data at minimum.
Implementation: Supabase encrypts at rest by default (AES-256). For custom: use pgcrypto extension.
Verification: Check provider's encryption documentation. Verify AES-256.
Risk_If_Ignored: Database breach = plaintext PII exposed. GDPR fine + customer trust destroyed.

Description: Set security headers: CSP HSTS X-Content-Type X-Frame-Options.
Implementation: Add headers in next.config.js or Vercel vercel.json. Use securityheaders.com to check.
Verification: Run securityheaders.com scan. Target A+ grade.

Description: Know what to do BEFORE a security incident. Who to notify how to contain.
Implementation: Write simple plan: 1) Detect 2) Contain 3) Assess 4) Notify affected users within 72hrs (GDPR) 5) Post-mortem.
Verification: Review plan quarterly. Update contact info.
Risk_If_Ignored: Panic response during incident. Missed GDPR 72-hour notification deadline. Legal liability.
Giantiny_Note: Giantiny ③ Write plan once use forever — 1 hour saves 100 hours of crisis panic
